intro: What is live on FI Signal Weekly, what is being built, and what is queued. Dates marked est. are estimates and may move. Showcase means a first public example; full means the feature is on the site for the planned set of institutions.

showcase_pages.note: Five institution pages are showcases of what every page will look like once the backfill and updates are done. New features land there first:

items.name: Provider fields on every FI page
items.description: Each institution page has a Technology providers section. Digital banking comes from a login-page scan or a verified announcement. Core is listed only when we have a verified public source.

items.name: FI page v2
items.description: A fuller institution page: asset trends, peer rank, branches and members, key executives, iBanknet, tech stack, merger and acquisition history, and similar institutions.

items.name: LinkedIn links and business digital banking
items.description: Institution pages will add the company's public LinkedIn page, when the institution publishes one, and the business digital banking provider when a public login-page scan or verified announcement supports it.

showcase.label: Glacier Bank
showcase.note: business online banking is live for 63 institutions

items.name: Territory view
items.description: A list of U.S. banks with assets strictly above $1.4 billion and an Eastern Time headquarters, grouped by HQ city, plus the same filter on the board and in the directory.

items.name: Vendor change feed, Jack Henry NetTeller retirement
items.description: A feed of public vendor platform notices. The first entry is Jack Henry's planned retirement of NetTeller Online Banking and Cash Management on July 1, 2027, with institutions that may be affected based on a login-page scan.

items.name: Vendor change feed, Fiserv
items.description: A later vendor-change entry covering Fiserv platform changes, once a public notice and scan evidence are in hand.

items.name: Release notes and roadmap
items.description: A What's new page with dated, plain-language release notes, and this public roadmap.

items.name: Asset chart benchmarks
items.description: Peer and industry overlays on asset charts, an inflation-adjusted toggle, and markers for mergers and acquisitions.

items.name: Strategic priorities
items.description: Stated strategic priorities on institution pages, with sourced quotes from public filings and reports.

showcase.note: on the Glacier Bank and BankUnited institution pages

milestones.label: All public banks and top credit unions

items.name: 2026 signal history backfill
items.description: Adding January through November 2026 buying-window signals to the board and institution pages, from public sources already in use.

items.name: Expanded news sources
items.description: A wider set of public news sources for buying-window signals, still limited to sources we can cite and fact-check.

items.name: Weekly website scans
items.description: A weekly login-page scan of institution websites to keep digital banking providers current and to catch public platform changes.

items.name: Quarterly call report refresh (Q3 2026 data)
items.description: Updating institution asset sizes from the FDIC and NCUA Q3 2026 call reports when that official data is published.

full.label: As soon as FDIC and NCUA post Q3 2026 data, early December

items.name: Help-page vendor detection
items.description: Checking public help, FAQ, and support pages for vendor names, as a lead only, alongside the login-page scan used for digital banking.

items.name: Estimated digital banking contract windows
items.description: Estimated windows when a digital banking contract may come up for renewal or replacement, labeled as estimates and tied to public evidence.

items.name: Tech and digital hiring counts
items.description: Counts of public technology and digital job postings at institutions, as a research aid, not a claim about anyone's vendor or core.

items.name: Hiring activity from bank and credit union careers pages
items.description: A view of hiring activity drawn from public careers pages at banks and credit unions.

items.name: Branch openings on institution pages
items.description: Branch openings listed on institution pages only, not on the board, starting on the showcase pages.

items.name: MCP server
items.description: Read-only access to published FI Signal data (signal search, FI profiles, new signals since a date, tech stack) for AI tools, with per-user API keys. M&A and executive moves first.

items.name: Latest added on the homepage
items.description: The newest signals sit at the top of the homepage, and new rows carry a New tag for 7 days.

items.name: Faster signal intake
items.description: Every signal is tracked from first sighting through fact-check to publish, so fresh news is prioritized and reaches the board within a business day.

items.name: Weekly coverage check
items.description: Each week we rebuild one day's signals independently from public sources and compare it with the board, to catch anything we missed.
